children: Axis Bank Limited Sponsored GDR RegS (NSE:AXISBANK) is expanding payments and AI: named PSP bank for RediffPay and affected by new UPI MDR rules, while deploying Axiom enterprise AI and warning rupee pressure under its FEER valuation amid analyst outreach.

: Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK): New UPI MDR from Oct 15 allows fees up to 0.4% over ₹2,000 and caps ₹300 at ≥₹75,000; Axis Bank revenue impact depends on its merchant vs P2P UPI mix and platform fee splits
: AXISBANK named PSP bank for RediffPay as NPCI-authorized TPAP, enabling Axis Bank to handle UPI payments and settlement for Rediff.com via RediffPay.
: Axis Bank (AXISBANK) says it uses the FEER model to value the rupee and warns the rupee may need to weaken due to trade shifts, lower AI-driven productivity gains, and higher oil prices.
: AXISBANK rolled out enterprise AI model Axiom, using AI across data validation, risk management, customer onboarding and operations to improve processes and controls.
: Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK) held an analyst/investor meet on Sept 18, 2026. Meeting notice filed with NSE/BSE; LSE and SGX informed. Presentation posted on the bank’s website.
